problems.reason: Sentence 24 claims Skorpiovenator lived in the Early Cretaceous (Albian), while sentences 18 and 19 state it shared a Late Cretaceous habitat with dinosaurs such as Argentinosaurus, Choconsaurus, Chucarosaurus, Mapusaurus, and Ilokelesia.
Sentences 26, 27, and 28 give conflicting age ranges for the Huincul Formation and the fossil strata: 106.2 Ma, 110.1–106.3 Ma, and 106.2 Ma respectively, which are inconsistent.
Sentences 20 and 21 both state that the genus and species were established/described by Canale et al. in 2008, repeating the same claim.

- contradiction: "The Huincul Formation, where Skorpiovenator fossils are found, is estimated to be 106.2 million years old." / "Skorpiovenator lived during the Albian stage, between 110.1 and 106.3 million years ago." / "The fossil strata containing the type specimen are now dated to the late Albian stage, approximately 106.2 million years ago.": Sentences 26, 27, and 28 give conflicting age ranges for the Huincul Formation and the fossil strata: 106.2 Ma, 110.1–106.3 Ma, and 106.2 Ma respectively, which are inconsistent.
